01

Authentication Bypass via Cookie/Storage Manipulation

HIGH
RISK

Client-side authentication controls could potentially be manipulated to bypass login and access protected resources.

RECOMMENDED FIX

Implement server-side authentication and authorization, validate sessions on every protected request, and securely configure session cookies.

Reported; fix confirmation pending
02

Hardcoded Administrative Password Hash

HIGH
RISK

Exposed password hash could potentially be cracked, leading to administrative account compromise if the password is recovered and remains valid.

RECOMMENDED FIX

Remove hardcoded credential material, rotate affected credentials, use Argon2id/bcrypt for password hashing, and audit administrative access.

Reported; fix confirmation pending
